rows.ARS:
Dark red Hybrid Tea, Cl..
Registration name: Crimson Glory, Cl
rows.Origin:
Discovered by Millar Bros. (South Africa, 1941). Discovered by Richardson (1944). Discovered by Antonio Naungayan (United States, 1946).
Introduced in United States by Jackson & Perkins Co. (Newark, NY) in 1946 as 'Crimson Glory, Cl'.
Introduced in United Kingdom by R Harkness & Co. Ltd. in 1948 as 'Climbing Crimson Glory'.
Introduced by Unknown (Australia) in before 1972 as 'Crimson Glory, Cl'.
rows.Bloom: Dark red. Strong fragrance. up to 30 petals. Average diameter 6". Very large, very double bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Patents: United States - Patent No: PP 736 on 13 Mar 1947 VIEW USPTO PATENT
rows.Parentage: sport of Crimson Glory (hybrid tea, Kordes 1935)
